Pricing plans

Acme offers three plans so teams of every size can get started quickly. Every plan includes unlimited projects, single sign-on, and email support during business hours.

Starter

The Starter plan costs twelve dollars per user per month and is designed for small teams that want the core features without any long-term commitment. You can cancel at any time.

Enterprise

The Enterprise plan adds audit logs, a dedicated account manager and a ninety-nine point nine percent uptime guarantee. Contact sales for volume pricing and custom contracts.

  • Audit logs retained for one year
  • SAML and SCIM provisioning
